headline: Clean: Silver Plus Account is the only savings product meeting all six needs, and the documented 14-day rule forces opening it before closing the Green Account.
solution_check: Silver Plus is the only savings account with 12-15 free withdrawals (15), a minimum the customer can keep ($2,500), daily compounding, ATM rebates (25), a relationship bonus (0.025%) and savings-goal tracking (silver_plus_004). Silver allows 10 withdrawals and documents no goals feature, Gold needs $10,000, Green allows 8, and Bronze allows 6. The Blue checking is 10 days old (opened 11/04/2025), so per general_002 the savings must be opened while Green (opened 07/17/2025, 120 days) is still open. Green is past its 60-day early-closure window with $0.00, so close_bank_account_7392 succeeds with no fee. This matches the gold, and replay confirms that closing first makes the savings open fail.
prior_note: Prior rated this clean; still clean.
notes: Grading-model facts re-checked against the v1.0.1 snapshot (evaluator_env.py, build.py _derive_read_log_allowlist, tools.py call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool, tasks.py compare_with_tool_call) and the verified scorer (_verified_db_match in the working repo, commit 4cb3191): all hold as stated. reward_basis is ['DB'] only. Replays used PYTHONPATH=<snapshot>/src, retrieval_variant='grep_only' (tools identical to default 'alltools', which needs an OpenAI key to build), and the gold-derived read_log_allowlist; scratch scripts in scratchpad/vs2_review_054/ (harness.py, apy.py). The verified scorer's closure_reason relaxation matters here: close_bank_account_7392 takes an optional free-text reason (default "Customer requested closure"). Replay with reason "Simplifying accounts" passes _verified_db_match but differs under the exact hash, so under upstream grading any custom reason would fail. general_005 lists "Notice period: 3 days" for MID-tier closures without saying what it means operationally. Its procedure goes straight from "Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period" to calling the tool, so closing today is the natural reading, but an agent that treats the notice period as a waiting period would not close. The v1.0.1 change to general_005 is cosmetic.
